cases.translation: To you, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
cases.explain: The transitive verb возношу (lift up) takes the accusative object.

cases.translation: In you, my God, I trust.
cases.explain: The verb уповаю requires the nominative subject 'I' (understood).

cases.sentence: Никто из надеющихся на тебя не постыдится, но пусть посрамятся те, кто вероломствует без ___.
cases.translation: No one who waits on you will be ashamed; they will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.
cases.explain: The preposition без (without) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Господи, покажи мне Твои пути, стезям Твоим научи ___.
cases.translation: Show me your ways, O Lord, teach me your paths.
cases.explain: The transitive verb научи (teach) takes the accusative object.

cases.translation: Remember, O Lord, your tender mercies and your loving kindnesses.
cases.explain: The transitive verb вспомни (remember) takes the accusative object.

cases.sentence: Наставь меня в Твоей истине, научи меня, потому что Ты — Бог моего ___.
cases.translation: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation.
cases.explain: The genitive case expresses possession with 'God of my salvation'.

cases.sentence: Не вспоминай грехов моей юности и проступков ___.
cases.translation: Do not remember the sins of my youth nor my transgressions.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used with possessive pronouns for the object of forgetting.

cases.sentence: По милости Твоей вспомни меня, потому что Ты благ, ___ спасения моего.
cases.translation: Remember me according to your mercy, O God of my salvation.
cases.explain: Vocative address uses the nominative case in Russian.

reading.ru: К тебе, Господи, возношу я душу мою.
reading.question: What does the psalmist lift up to the Lord?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'возношу я душу мою' (I lift up my soul).

reading.ru: На тебя, мой Бог, уповаю. Да не буду я постыжен, да не будут враги мои торжествовать.
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask in terms of shame and enemies?
options: That his enemies will be punished severely
That he will not be ashamed and his enemies will not triumph
That he will defeat all his enemies
That shame will fall on all nations
reading.correct: That he will not be ashamed and his enemies will not triumph
reading.explain: The text states 'Да не буду я постыжен, да не будут враги мои торжествовать.'

reading.ru: Никто из надеющихся на тебя не постыдится вовек, но пусть посрамятся те, кто вероломствует без причины.
reading.question: Who will not be shamed, and who will be shamed?
options: The righteous will not be shamed, sinners will be
Those who trust in God will not be shamed, but traitors will be
The strong will be honored, the weak will be humiliated
Israel will be saved, its enemies will be destroyed
reading.correct: Those who trust in God will not be shamed, but traitors will be
reading.explain: The text states those who hope in God will not be shamed, but those who betray without cause will be.

reading.ru: Господи, покажи мне Твои пути, стезям Твоим научи меня.
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask the Lord to show and teach him?
options: The secrets of the future and how to gain riches
Military strategy and how to defeat enemies
The names of God and his titles
reading.explain: The text directly states the psalmist asks to be shown God's ways and taught his paths.

reading.ru: Вспомни, Господи, любовь свою и милость, потому что они извечны.
reading.question: What qualities of the Lord does the psalmist ask Him to remember?
options: His love and mercy, which are eternal
reading.correct: His love and mercy, which are eternal
reading.explain: The text states 'вспомни...любовь свою и милость...потому что они извечны.'

reading.ru: По милости Твоей вспомни меня, потому что Ты благ, Господи.
reading.question: On what basis does the psalmist ask God to remember him?
options: On the basis of his own righteousness
On the basis of his suffering
On the basis of God's mercy and goodness
On the basis of his good works
reading.correct: On the basis of God's mercy and goodness
reading.explain: The text states 'По милости Твоей' (according to your mercy) and 'Ты благ' (you are good).
